items.title: Volkswagen abandons hopes for 2026 sales growth as restructuring looms
items.summary: The German auto group, which includes subsidiaries Porsche and Audi, reported ​an operating profit ​of €3.5 billion ($3.98 billion) in the April-to-June period.

items.title: Maruti bets on performance, premiumisation to reclaim Brezza's lead status as compact SUV battle intensifies
items.summary: The product refresh of Brezza, which debuted in 2016, comes at a time when compact SUV category continues to outperform most other PV segments.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz India rolls out E25-compliant cars amid biofuel push
items.summary: Customer demand shows a growing interest in electric mobility and hybrid technologies. Mercedes-Benz India expects stable luxury car sales with single-digit growth this year.

items.title: Kia launches Syros EV from ₹13.49 lakh with up to 526 km range
items.summary: The second made-in-India mass-market EV from Kia gets up to 80% assured buyback, a BaaS option, a lifetime battery warranty, and 100 kW DC fast charging.

items.title: Harman India in Talks with 2W, CV Makers to Supply Infotainment Systems
items.summary: Harman India is in discussions with multiple two-wheeler and commercial vehicle manufacturers to supply in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) and cockpit domain controller (CDC) systems, according to a senior company executive. This would mark Harman Automotive’s expansion beyond its traditional passenger vehicle business in India.

items.title: CEAT to Invest ₹1,205 Crore to Expand Two-Wheeler Tyre Capacity by 66%
items.summary: CEAT plans to invest around ₹1,205 crore to expand its two-wheeler tyre manufacturing capacity by about 66% as the existing capacity at its Nagpur plant nears full utilisation. The tyre maker will add around 53,000 tyres a day in phases by the end of FY31.

items.title: Gabriel India to Invest ₹180 Crore in New Capacity, Automation in FY27
items.summary: Gabriel India plans to invest around ₹180 crore in its standalone business in FY27, with the proposed spending covering a new plant at Hosur and capacity expansion across some of its existing facilities. The company expects a large part of its two-wheeler growth to come from the new Hosur facility, Atul Jaggi, Group President, ANAND Group, and Managing Director of Gabriel India, told Autocar Professional.

items.title: BorgWarner Wins Supply Contract for Motorcycle Transmissions in China
items.summary: BorgWarner has secured a new Dual-Clutch Transmission (DCT) program with an unnamed Chinese motorcycle manufacturer, scheduled to enter production in the third quarter of 2027, the company announced on Friday. What the Supply Package Includes Under the contract, BorgWarner will supply a package consisting of dual clutches, hydraulic control modules, and clutch control software.

items.summary: Under a joint venture that will be 66 per cent owned by Ford and 34 per cent by the Chinese firm, the first Geely brand electric SUVs will roll off the Valencia plant's production line in 2028.

items.title: Sona Comstar and DENSO Form Joint Ventures for Electric Powertrains
items.summary: Sona Comstar has signed definitive agreements with Japan-based DENSO Corporation to establish two joint ventures in India focused on electric and hybrid powertrain systems. Under the terms of the agreement, the first joint venture will focus on electric and hybrid four-wheelers and larger vehicles.

items.summary: The partnership will develop traction motors, inverters, generators and e-Axles across passenger, commercial, two- and three-wheeler segments, with India as the manufacturing and development hub.

items.title: Honda launches ZR-V Hybrid SUV in India at ₹47.99 lakh, begins deliveries
items.summary: The ZR-V e:HEV is powered by Honda’s 2.0-litre e:HEV Sports Hybrid powertrain, delivering a combined maximum power of 184 PS at 5,000-6,000 rpm and maximum torque of 315 Nm at 0-2,000 rpm.

items.title: MAHLE Explores India Debut for AI Cabin System; Flags Rare-Earth-Free Motor Potential
items.summary: German automotive supplier MAHLE is positioning India as a lead market for new technologies, with the country emerging as a candidate for the first launch of its AI-based cabin climate system. Management also sees strong potential for its rare-earth-free electric motor, but has not confirmed an India launch for either technology.

items.title: Shakti Pumps Invests ₹5 Crore in EV Mobility Subsidiary
items.summary: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has invested ₹5 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary, Shakti EV Mobility Private Limited, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges. The capital infusion was executed through the cash subscription of 50 lakh equity shares possessing a face value of ₹10 each.
